overview: Compton Farm is a working farm at Brook with a camping meadow and a dozen static caravans, about a quarter of a mile from Compton Bay. It opens from May to October, has shower blocks and a small laundry, and welcomes dogs on a lead. Walkers and cyclists can get half-price pitches when there is space.
surfTripFit: The nearest place to stay to Compton Bay, close enough to walk down for a session and back for a hot shower.
